Zvi Benami Attention is all you need Built on the Transformer Architecture, introduced in the seminal paper MI Attention Is All You Need" by Vaswani et al. in 2017. Output Probabilities Softmax  https: [ [arxiv org [pdf/1706.03762 pdf It revolutionized natural language processing by relying solely on attention mechanisms, eliminating the need for recurrence and convolutions. Core Concepts Self-Attention Mechanism: Allows the model to weigh the importance of different words in an input sequence, enabling it to capture contextual relationships regardless of their distance in the sequence. Parallelization: Unlike RNNs, Transformers process entire sequences simultaneously, leading to faster training times and better scalability: Encoder-Decoder Structure: The architecture consists of an encoder to process input data and a decoder to generate output; both built from layers that include multi-head self-attention and feed-forward neural networks. Zvi Benami Training Process Learning to Predict the Next Token Objective: Minimize prediction error (typically cross-entropy loss) Input: Tokenized text sequences (e.g,, from books, web pages, code) Output: Probability distribution over vocabulary for the next token Input sequence Softmax layer Transformer Prediction During training, the model calculates a probability for every token in the vocabulary: The loss is computed by comparing the predicted token to the actual next token, and weights are updated via backpropagation. 22 arana muanmaln ~DulJrJ
